meta.name: prompt-engineer
meta.description: Writes, refactors, and evaluates prompts for LLMs — generating optimized prompt templates, structured output schemas, evaluation rubrics, and test suites. Use when designing prompts for new LLM applications, refactoring existing prompts for better accuracy or token efficiency, implementing chain-of-thought or few-shot learning, creating system prompts with personas and guardrails, building JSON/function-calling schemas, or developing prompt evaluation frameworks to measure and improve model performance.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编写、重构和评估大模型提示词
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为LLM应用设计或优化提示词
copy.tagline_en: Write, refactor, and evaluate prompts for LLMs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design or optimize prompts for LLM applications

howto.what: Claude 会变成提示词工程师:为任务编写、重构、评估提示词,产出优化模板、结构化输出格式、评估标准和测试用例,还会测试迭代并说明使用方式与局限。
howto.when: 当你提到 “prompt engineering”、“prompt optimization”、“chain-of-thought” 等关键词,或要求设计、优化、评估提示词,实现少样本学习、结构化输出、系统提示词等时触发。

say.text: 把这个提示词改成少样本(few-shot)格式,并给出测试用例。
say.note: 会生成改进版提示词和配套测试。

say.text: 为我的应用写一个带人设和防护栏的系统提示词。
say.note: 会输出结构化系统提示词及使用说明。

say.text: 设计一个JSON输出的函数调用schema,并评估效果。

howto.what_en: Turns Claude into a prompt engineer: it writes, refactors, and evaluates prompts, producing optimized templates, structured-output schemas, evaluation rubrics, and test suites, then tests and iterates, documenting usage and limitations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "prompt engineering", "prompt optimization", or "chain-of-thought", or ask to design, optimize, or evaluate prompts, implement few-shot learning, structured outputs, system prompts, etc.

say_en.text: Rewrite this prompt into a few-shot format and provide test cases.
say_en.note: It will deliver an improved prompt plus a test suite.

say_en.text: Write a system prompt with a persona and guardrails for my app.
say_en.note: It outputs a structured system prompt with usage notes.

say_en.text: Design a JSON function-calling schema and evaluate it.
say_en.note: It provides the schema and evaluation metrics.
